body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Urbanears(www.urbanears.com) launched its new headphones 'Plattan' at CES 2010, utilizing innovative functions and performance with today's technology.

It is a full size headphone allowing for rich, secluded sound. It can be folded down to the size of user's fist for maximum mobility. Plattan also comes with a "zound plug" on the earcap, allowing for a friend to plug in and enjoy music.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
